newsitem.title: USA: CBOT financial futures closed on Monday, Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: CBOT financial futures closed on Monday, Nov 11.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade's (CBOT) financial and insurance futures and futures-options trading will be shut on Monday, November 11, for the U.S. Veterans Day holiday, the exchange said.
The CBOT said it revised its trading hours for the products, including U.S. Treasury bond contracts, which originally were slated to be open on Monday.
All other CBOT trading, including agricultural contracts, will observe normal hours on Monday.

Project A afternoon session will be shut on Monday, but evening pit trading and the overnight Project A session will be open, the CBOT said. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
